summary: Design agent produced minimal LLD for Bug #88 (all interactive elements non-functional). Identified 6 disconnected wiring points (DC-1 through DC-6) across App.tsx, Viewport.tsx, BrickPalette.tsx, Toolbar.tsx, and interaction hooks. LLD prescribes exact code changes, interface contracts, implementation order, and maps to 12 regression test IDs already authored by the frontend-test agent on branch bugfix/88-interactive-elements-wiring.

human_review_required.reason: Human must approve the LLD before coding agent proceeds

recommended_actions: Read docs/bugs/88/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md — all 6 disconnection points and exact fixes are specified
Implement fixes in the order prescribed in Section 11 (DC-6 → DC-3 → DC-4/5 → DC-2 → DC-1)
Work on branch bugfix/88-interactive-elements-wiring (tests already authored there)
Run regression tests T-BUG-88-01 through T-BUG-88-12 after each fix
Verify all existing tests still pass before opening implementation PR
